---
title: "SMS Code Entry Rate"
description: "Share of SMS codes sent that someone entered correctly."
---

The proportion of SMS one-time codes sent over a selected reporting period that
someone went on to enter correctly.

This is the clearest signal of automated traffic in the MFA data. Bots that
request codes they cannot read drive codes sent up without codes entered, so the
entry rate falls on those days while the [MFA Success Rate](mfa-success-rate.qmd)
barely moves.

The two rates have different denominators. The success rate divides successes by
attempts (success plus failure), so a code that is never entered does not appear
in it at all. The entry rate divides successes by codes sent, so every unentered
code counts against it. Do not quote one as the other: on a typical day the entry
rate sits far below the success rate.

## Calculation

Restrict to `mfa_type = 'sms_otp'`. Divide the sum of `count` where
`result = 'success'` by the sum of `count` where `result = 'sent'`. To see a bot
day, compute it per day rather than over the whole window.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Example queries"}

::: {.panel-tabset}

## SQL

Overall:

```sql
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(count) FILTER (WHERE result = 'success') AS DOUBLE)
        / NULLIF(SUM(count) FILTER (WHERE result = 'sent'), 0)
        AS sms_code_entry_rate
FROM ibm_verify_events_transformed.events_mfa_activity
-- set the reporting window; see the timespans note in cookbook/notes.qmd
WHERE CAST(from_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-05-28'
  AND mfa_type = 'sms_otp';
```

By day:

```sql
SELECT
    CAST(from_date AS DATE) AS day,
    SUM(count) FILTER (WHERE result = 'sent') AS sms_codes_sent,
    SUM(count) FILTER (WHERE result = 'success') AS sms_codes_entered,
    CAST(SUM(count) FILTER (WHERE result = 'success') AS DOUBLE)
        / NULLIF(SUM(count) FILTER (WHERE result = 'sent'), 0)
        AS sms_code_entry_rate
FROM ibm_verify_events_transformed.events_mfa_activity
-- set the reporting window; see the timespans note in cookbook/notes.qmd
WHERE CAST(from_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-05-28'
  AND mfa_type = 'sms_otp'
GROUP BY CAST(from_date AS DATE)
ORDER BY day;
```

## R

Overall:

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_transformed", "events_mfa_activity")) |>
  # set the reporting window; see the timespans note in cookbook/notes.qmd
  filter(
    as.Date(from_date) >= as.Date("2026-01-01"),
    as.Date(from_date) <= as.Date("2026-05-28"),
    mfa_type == "sms_otp"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    sms_code_entry_rate =
      sum(if_else(result == "success", as.double(count), 0), na.rm = TRUE) /
        sum(if_else(result == "sent", as.double(count), 0), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

By day:

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_transformed", "events_mfa_activity")) |>
  # set the reporting window; see the timespans note in cookbook/notes.qmd
  filter(
    as.Date(from_date) >= as.Date("2026-01-01"),
    as.Date(from_date) <= as.Date("2026-05-28"),
    mfa_type == "sms_otp"
  ) |>
  mutate(day = as.Date(from_date)) |>
  group_by(day) |>
  summarise(
    sms_codes_sent = sum(if_else(result == "sent", count, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    sms_codes_entered =
      sum(if_else(result == "success", count, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    sms_code_entry_rate =
      sum(if_else(result == "success", as.double(count), 0), na.rm = TRUE) /
        sum(if_else(result == "sent", as.double(count), 0), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(day)
```

:::

:::

## Interpretation notes

The rate is a proportion between 0 and 1. The Automated Traffic dashboard flags
a day when the rate falls well below a typical day while codes sent rise; its
thresholds live there, not here.

## Alternative names

- SMS OTP entry rate
- SMS code completion rate
- codes entered per code sent
